meta.name: social-creative-designer
meta.description: Creative Designer skill. Takes a post concept, a client product photo, or a real lifestyle photo and produces on-brand social media visuals using the client's brand style guide. Four modes — Generate (AI image from concept), Composite (client product photo anchored in an AI-generated scene), Brand (apply text overlay treatment to a real client photo), Stop-Motion Reel (6-frame action sequence exported as MP4). Reads brand-style.md, builds prompts, generates/edits images via Nano Banana MCP, outputs images + prompt log + creative brief.
